roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: A role is a set of system functions. Create as many as you need and then fine-tune each user separately.
roles.delete_msg: Users who have it will stop receiving its functions.
roles.delete_msg_members: {{count}} user(s) have it and will stop receiving its functions.
roles.functions_hint: Check what this role can do. Changes apply to every user with the role.
roles.scope_hint: Applies to people who have the “View sales” function. You can change it any time, and also per user (Users → Permissions).
roles.scope_own_hint: They see the orders they created or where they are the seller. Others do not show up (not in lists, dashboard, reports or notifications).
roles.scope_all_hint: They see every order in the company, whoever it belongs to.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: People with access to this company. Each can have one or several roles and individual exceptions.
users.password_hint: Leave empty only if the user already exists in another company.
users.admin_hint: Administrators can do everything; individual permissions do not apply to them.
users.roles_hint: Can have several; their functions add up.
users.tech_hint: Their technician number is {{n}}: it is part of the code of the units they test.
users.perms_hint: Adjust functions for this user without changing their role: “Allow” grants a function their roles do not; “Deny” removes one they do.
users.password_reset_done: Password reset. The user will have to change it when signing in.
users.reset_hint: At least 8 characters. They will be asked to change it on sign-in.
users.owner_locked: This is the main administrator created when the system was installed: it is unique and cannot be changed or removed.
users.scope_role_own: By role: only their own sales
users.scope_hint: Choose whether this user sees only the orders they created or where they are the seller, or everyone's. “By role” changes nothing.
